abilities.description: The Twin Fates guide your destiny. Every few days, check the Fates: set your stats to their normal values, then roll the challenge dice as Cinder and Wraith. If Cinder is higher, raise iron or heart by 1 and lower edge or shadow by 1. If Wraith is higher, reverse this. On a match, choose which holds sway. Mark the adjusted stats as fated. When you make a move with a fated stat, take +1 momentum on a match.
Choose Cinder or Wraith as your favored Fate. While that moon holds sway, increase your momentum reset by 1.

While Cinder holds sway, you may envision a prophetic glimpse of a fierce foe or ardent lover. While Wraith holds sway, it reveals a secret rival or mysterious benefactor. @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.bd6278f18bbd6739]{Ask the Oracle} for three details about that fated individual. Once per detail, when you make a move acting on the foresight, reroll any dice.
